technicalAssessment.reason: R3 preserves the R2 rebind without adding feature-specific behavior cases. acceptanceCases.then: Return any produced transcript as an unverified, source-version/timebase-linked draft and identify the glossary version used; keep this operation distinct from punctuation and capitalization.
acceptanceCases.rejection: Reject silently applying an ambiguous, unsupported, or unavailable glossary entry, or claiming that glossary guidance verifies transcript correctness.

acceptanceCases.given: An authorized source version is admitted for speech transcription and filler/retake analysis.
acceptanceCases.when: The actor requests ASR-assisted filler-word or retake detection.
acceptanceCases.then: Return only uncertain candidate observations anchored to the exact source version and time range, distinct from silence observations.
acceptanceCases.rejection: Reject classifying silence alone as a filler or retake, or automatically deleting, trimming, or cutting source content from a candidate observation.

acceptanceCases.given: A user requests translation of a source speech or transcript version to a declared target locale and supplies any translation-memory or brand-glossary references and approved term entries available for that request.
acceptanceCases.when: The translation operation is evaluated and, if admitted, prepares a translated draft.
acceptanceCases.then: Apply only admitted, versioned, approved, unambiguous, applicable source/target term pairs or do-not-translate entries; preserve the memory and glossary versions and identify which protected terms were retained. Present translated content as a draft, not as approved or verified text. For an otherwise admitted translation request with a missing or unavailable memory or glossary, explicitly report that it was not applied; do not silently substitute another entry, glossary, or translation behavior. If a supplied memory or glossary is denied, stale, ambiguous, conflicting, or unknown, report that state; if source authorization or rights are denied or unknown, block the operation under the family admission behavior in MEDIA-REQ-CAP-SPEECH-TRANSCRIPTION-AC-02 with no fallback. For any dubbed result, preserve every supplied per-segment speaker, locale, source-timing, and translation-provenance field. If a field is not supplied or cannot be established, identify it as absent or unknown rather than silently omitting or fabricating it; mark a field not applicable only with an explicit reason. This case does not establish audio/video export synchronization, which remains a separate requirement.
acceptanceCases.rejection: Reject changing a term marked do-not-translate, silently omitting an unresolved protected term, applying an unversioned, unapproved, or inapplicable entry, resolving conflicting entries by silent preference, or describing a translated draft as owner-approved or verified.

acceptanceCases.given: An authorized microphone recording session and an admitted transcription request refer to the same exact captured source version.
acceptanceCases.when: The product prepares a transcript draft or paired archive candidate.
acceptanceCases.then: Link the transcript to the source version, capture session, and timebase while retaining the recording as an independently identifiable immutable artifact.
acceptanceCases.rejection: Reject implying archive registration, changing either artifact without separate authorization, or claiming a resolved pair when source identity or alignment is unknown.

acceptanceCases.rejection: reject implying that voice conditioning authored, verified, or authorized response text or its claims; reject presenting generated text as a user statement, verified fact, or approved communication.

acceptanceCases.rejection: reject omitting the provenance needed to distinguish the source and model used for the derived voice result.

acceptanceCases.then: provide a response attributable to the current user-initiated turn, distinguish observed or transcribed input from generated response text and synthesized audio, expose whether the turn is still streaming or complete, and preserve interruption and cancellation as explicit outcomes; do not modify a project or publish a response as a separate effect.
acceptanceCases.rejection: reject hidden or background microphone capture, continuing capture after the user ends the session, representing partial or uncertain recognition as confirmed input, or reporting a complete response when the outcome is unknown or unavailable.

If authorization, source/audio/voice/package rights or license, M4B format support, profile admission, or qualification is denied, absent, or unknown, apply MEDIA-REQ-CAP-SPEECH-SYNTHESIS-AC-02; never report the requested format as available on unknown evidence or imply completed delivery.
acceptanceCases.rejection: Reject flattening or reordering supplied boundaries, inventing chapter metadata, silently substituting a format or voice, or representing candidate metadata as proof of qualified format support, completed audio, or delivery.

acceptanceCases.given: A creator supplies an authorized, rights-cleared source, ordered text segments, and an authorized, rights-cleared, admitted voice/personality profile with the exact shared context intended to govern their synthesis.
acceptanceCases.when: Media prepares speech for those segments as one continuous work.
acceptanceCases.then: Represent the declared segment order and shared context/profile as requested candidate properties; report continuity as established only for segments where the admitted operation establishes it, and expose other segments as denied, unsupported, or unknown. Apply MEDIA-REQ-CAP-SPEECH-SYNTHESIS-AC-02 if source, voice, profile, authorization, rights, or license admission is denied, absent, or unknown; a candidate property does not guarantee audible continuity.
acceptanceCases.rejection: Reject claiming cross-segment continuity from unrelated or missing context, silently changing the declared profile, or treating an unavailable or unknown continuity result as established or guaranteeing audible identity/continuity.

acceptanceCases.given: An authorized creator supplies an ordered story or speech plan with explicit segment boundaries and an authorized speaker assignment for each segment.
acceptanceCases.when: The product prepares or generates speech for the ordered segments.
acceptanceCases.then: Preserve segment order and boundaries, bind each segment to its exact authorized speaker and applicable rights evidence, and return per-segment voice, source, and generated-audio provenance with any unavailable assignment marked explicitly.
acceptanceCases.rejection: Reject using a speaker without current authorization for the segment and purpose, silently substituting a voice or reordering segments, or claiming a generated artifact is committed when it is only a candidate.

acceptanceCases.given: An authorized synthesis request pins the exact requested speaker or voice, model/checkpoint, profile, worker, and source version for the declared purpose.
acceptanceCases.when: Media returns a generated-audio candidate or execution observation.
acceptanceCases.then: Report requested and observed speaker/voice, model/checkpoint, profile, worker, and source identities separately for the exact output; preserve mismatch or unobserved identity as UNKNOWN and retain the output as synthetic media.
acceptanceCases.rejection: Reject silently substituting a speaker, voice, model, checkpoint, profile, or worker; inferring the effective identity from the request alone; or treating a configured identity as proof of the output's authorship, rights, or authenticity.

acceptanceCases.given: An authorized editor submits a scene patch against an exact project and scene revision, and a later revision contains overlapping changes.

acceptanceCases.rejection: Reject silently applying a patch to a changed scene, choosing a conflict winner without authorization, or claiming a committed revision while the result is pending, unknown, or unavailable.

acceptanceCases.given: An authorized project owner requests a portable backup of one exact project revision.

acceptanceCases.then: Identify the exact project revision, included immutable asset versions, external references, and omitted, unavailable, or rights-restricted content; call the backup complete only when every required item and integrity check is accounted for, and restore as a new revision that preserves the originals.
acceptanceCases.rejection: Reject implying completeness when inclusion or integrity is unknown, silently replacing an external reference, or restoring over the source revision.

acceptanceCases.given: An actor requests an active-speaker-aware multicamera cut proposal from admitted speaker-turn and camera-source observations.
acceptanceCases.when: The product prepares the proposal.
acceptanceCases.then: Return a reviewable local candidate that links each proposed cut to its speaker-turn and camera-source evidence and makes uncertainty explicit.
acceptanceCases.rejection: Reject inferring missing speaker/camera evidence or committing the proposal to the project without an explicit separate approval.

acceptanceCases.given: An authorized editor selects exact audio-track versions and declares gain, pan, and time-varying automation points with a timebase and project revision.
acceptanceCases.when: The product prepares the multitrack edit.
acceptanceCases.then: Return a local reviewable candidate that preserves track and source-version identities, records the requested automation points and any validation uncertainty, and leaves project state unchanged until explicit confirmation.
acceptanceCases.rejection: Reject collapsing automation to an undocumented static value, mutating the project or source audio before confirmation, or implying a rendered output from the candidate.

acceptanceCases.given: An authorized editor selects an exact speech source version and specifies a sample-time region edit, including intended boundaries and any crossfade parameters.
acceptanceCases.when: The product prepares the speech edit against the declared sample rate and timebase.
acceptanceCases.then: Return a reviewable local candidate with exact source-version and sample-boundary references, disclose boundary quantization or crossfade validation uncertainty, and preserve the source and project revision.
acceptanceCases.rejection: Reject silently shifting boundaries, inventing crossfade values, modifying the source, or claiming the candidate has been rendered or committed.

acceptanceCases.given: An authorized editor requests overlay placement in apparent free space for an exact source version and time interval.
acceptanceCases.when: The product evaluates detected free-space evidence and prepares a placement suggestion.
acceptanceCases.then: Return an uncertain local placement candidate tied to the exact source version, time range, declared overlay, and detection context, preserving the evidence and allowing review before any composition change.
acceptanceCases.rejection: Reject presenting detected free space as guaranteed safe or unobstructed, omitting uncertainty or source-time context, or applying or rendering the placement without explicit authorization.

acceptanceCases.given: An authorized creator selects a branded motion template and supplies typed editable parameters bound to identified brand assets and a project revision.
acceptanceCases.when: The product instantiates the template as a composition proposal.
acceptanceCases.then: Return an editable local candidate that identifies the template version, each typed parameter and its binding, exact source and brand-asset versions, and unresolved parameter constraints; leave the project unchanged pending review and confirmation.
acceptanceCases.rejection: Reject silently substituting brand assets or parameter values, claiming preview or render parity without evidence, or committing the proposal before confirmation.

acceptanceCases.given: An authorized editor has a take intent classified as captured ADR, generated narration, or captured or generated room tone, with exact source or session provenance and a declared timeline location.
acceptanceCases.when: The product prepares placement in the multitrack composition.
acceptanceCases.then: Return a reviewable local placement candidate that preserves the content-origin distinction, exact source or generation provenance, intended time range, and any alignment uncertainty without mutating the project.
acceptanceCases.rejection: Reject relabeling generated narration as captured ADR, treating a recording intent as captured content, conflating captured and generated room tone, or committing or rendering the edit without explicit authorization.

acceptanceCases.given: An authorized editor declares protected text or logo regions on an exact source version, or detection evidence for those regions is uncertain.
acceptanceCases.when: Media prepares an overlay or reframe candidate.
acceptanceCases.then: Preserve declared protected regions or mark the candidate unresolved for review, retaining source-version and time-range evidence.
acceptanceCases.rejection: Reject claiming protected content is preserved when region evidence is absent or uncertain, changing the source, or committing the candidate without confirmation.

acceptanceCases.given: An authorized editor declares a target aspect ratio, exact source version, time range, and eligible subject evidence for automatic framing.
acceptanceCases.when: Media prepares a subject-aware framing candidate.
acceptanceCases.then: Bind the candidate to the declared target and source-time evidence and disclose uncertainty and any crop or excluded source region.
acceptanceCases.rejection: Reject claiming all subjects or content remain in frame when evidence is uncertain, silently changing aspect ratio, or modifying or rendering the source without confirmation.

acceptanceCases.given: An authorized editor selects exact track versions and declares track-to-bus assignments, send routing, pre/post-fader position, and any bus or track effect-chain version for one project revision.
acceptanceCases.when: Media prepares the multitrack routing candidate.
acceptanceCases.then: Return a local, reviewable routing graph that preserves the declared assignments, routing, gain/pan/automation, effect-chain identities, and source versions and exposes unresolved compatibility; leave the project and audio unchanged pending explicit confirmation.
acceptanceCases.rejection: Reject inferred routing or effect values, cycles or unsupported graphs, silent track/bus substitution, source mutation, project commit, rendering, export, or qualified loudness/true-peak claims.

acceptanceCases.rejection: reject presenting an estimate as measured cost, a quality result, or authorization to run.

acceptanceCases.when: the reviewer requests a variant comparison and possible feedback action.
acceptanceCases.then: compare only the attributed observations and prepare a feedback proposal for explicit user approval without inferring causal effect.
acceptanceCases.rejection: reject implying access to external platform APIs or data, silently importing observations, or claiming a variant caused an outcome.

Never auto-switch choices, execute the plan, exceed the budget, silently downgrade quality, or substitute another pipeline.
acceptanceCases.rejection: Reject representing estimates as measured quality or resource use, changing the selected tradeoff without an explicit request, or presenting a candidate plan as authorization, qualification, or completed processing.

acceptanceCases.rejection: Reject claiming a highlight is objectively memorable, ranking with an undeclared objective or hidden weights, or omitting the exact source version and time span.

acceptanceCases.rejection: Reject silently changing the source candidate or target audience/channel, inferring a universal preference score, or presenting a ranking produced by undeclared criteria.

acceptanceCases.then: Return reviewable candidates with exact source version and source-time span, supporting evidence, uncertainty, and rights decision reference; do not attach a candidate to the project.
acceptanceCases.rejection: Reject treating a recommendation as source acceptance or project mutation; missing or unknown rights or source-time evidence makes the candidate ineligible or unresolved.

acceptanceCases.given: An authorized reviewer evaluates a QA claim that includes a product or business-state assertion.

acceptanceCases.then: Separate media-quality observations from authoritative owner-system readback and bind any state assertion to the exact owner reference, revision, and observation time.
acceptanceCases.rejection: Reject substituting a media score, decoded output, execution log, or job acknowledgment for owner readback; absent or stale readback remains UNKNOWN and blocks the business-state claim.

acceptanceCases.rejection: Reject inferring ownership, infringement, license, permission, legal clearance, or definitive identity from similarity; missing or unknown inputs, method, transformation scope, or authority cannot become a positive finding.

acceptanceCases.then: Bind requested and effective controls to each output or shot with the exact prompt, reference, guidance, checkpoint/model, profile, and seed identities when available; report whether each control was applied, estimated, unsupported, or unknown with method provenance, disclose applicable cost/safety/rights observations, and label the result as synthetic media rather than physical capture or product-action proof.
acceptanceCases.rejection: Reject silently ignoring or substituting a declared control, asserting physical camera behavior from a synthetic candidate, or claiming support when the model/profile binding is unknown.

acceptanceCases.given: An authorized creator saves or reapplies a versioned preset from an exact generation's effective parameter manifest, prompt/reference identities, model/checkpoint, profile, seed, and source job.
acceptanceCases.when: The creator applies that preset to a new generation request.
acceptanceCases.then: Preserve the preset version and source job, show requested-versus-effective parameter differences, and require fresh authority, rights, budget, capability, license, and runtime admission for the new invocation; saving or reapplying does not replay, mutate, or replace the prior output or establish reproducibility.
acceptanceCases.rejection: Reject a missing or inaccessible source manifest, silent parameter substitution, treating reuse as reproducibility or admission, or implying that the prior output was regenerated.

acceptanceCases.given: An authorized creator submits a generation request with explicit shot intervals, per-shot prompt overrides, optional rights-cleared masks, region trajectories or motion-brush conditions, and timeline/keyframe anchors bound to an exact source version and timebase.
acceptanceCases.when: Media prepares the shot-conditioned generation candidate.
acceptanceCases.then: Bind each prompt, mask, region trajectory, motion-brush condition, and anchor to its declared shot/time range, region identity, source version, and timebase; report applied, unsupported, estimated, or unknown constraints per shot and distinguish generated conditions from authored or observed scene facts.
acceptanceCases.rejection: Reject invalid ranges or unresolved conflicting overlaps without an explicit precedence policy, masks without required rights, silently applying shot instructions to the whole clip, or claiming unsupported controls were honored; unknown support, region/time mapping, or rights blocks the affected scope.

acceptanceCases.given: An authorized creator requests a video-to-video appearance transformation involving an identifiable person and declares the exact source version and purpose.
acceptanceCases.when: Media prepares a candidate recast or altered-presenter output.
acceptanceCases.then: Preserve source identity and transformation provenance, identify the result as synthetic or altered, and require the applicable MEDIA-REQ-CAP-RIGHTS-AC-04 rights, consent, and license decision before use; unknown decision or transformation support remains blocked or UNKNOWN.
acceptanceCases.rejection: Reject treating disclosure as authorization, inferring identity or rights from a reference alone, replacing the source silently, or claiming a generated result is product-action proof.

acceptanceCases.given: An authorized creator requests joint audio-video generation and declares exact input identities, intended audio/video relation, source timebase, and output profile.
acceptanceCases.when: Media prepares the generation candidate.
acceptanceCases.then: Bind candidate audio and video identities and their declared relation to the exact request and source versions; record applied, unsupported, estimated, or UNKNOWN relation state and provenance without asserting a universal synchronization or quality threshold.
acceptanceCases.rejection: Reject silently substituting either modality or inferring synchronized output when the relation or observation is absent, unsupported, or unknown.

acceptanceCases.given: An authorized creator requests generated dialogue or sound effects related to lip motion and declares exact source versions, intended time relation, and timebase.
acceptanceCases.when: Media prepares the speech/video generation candidate.
acceptanceCases.then: Bind the candidate speech/audio identity to the declared visual or lip-motion observation and timebase; preserve whether alignment was applied, estimated, unsupported, or UNKNOWN with method provenance, without claiming a universal lip-sync guarantee.
acceptanceCases.rejection: Reject fabricating a lip-motion observation, silently substituting speech or source versions, or claiming alignment absent source-bound evidence.

capabilities.label: Import artifact
capabilities.outcome: Resolve an admitted source reference or staged upload and report a governed import observation. When an authorized sidecar or embedded caption track is explicitly requested and observed for the exact immutable source version, the result may include its track identity, source timebase and any explicit mapping, language and format when known, conversion or alignment uncertainty, and provenance; this does not alter source media or register a caption as an artifact. Create a governed artifact version only after source authority, integrity, and owner-confirmed registration requirements are satisfied. Unknown source, mapping, or registration remains unknown.

optionalSemanticObservations.when: An authorized sidecar or embedded caption track is explicitly requested and observed in the exact immutable imported source version.

fields.captionTrackRef: Track identity or source location as observed.
fields.language: Observed language tag when available; otherwise UNKNOWN.
fields.format: Observed sidecar format or embedded track encoding when available; otherwise UNKNOWN.
fields.timingMapping: Declared source timebase, any explicit mapping applied, and conversion or alignment uncertainty.
fields.provenance: Whether the track was observed embedded or supplied as an authorized sidecar.

constraints: Observation does not alter source media, register or replace a canonical artifact, or claim caption correctness.
Missing, malformed, or unknown track mapping remains explicit.

preconditions: The source reference is resolvable under current actor, tenant, workspace, and source-system authority.
The source is permitted for the requested import purpose and locality; external fetch/egress behavior is explicitly authorized.
The target workspace and optional project are authorized; artifact integrity and retention rules are defined by the owning service.
constraints: Import is not upload: an external source reference may resolve to bytes or an existing immutable artifact according to the owner contract.
Resolution never bypasses source-system permission, policy, locality, or retention requirements.
No artifact is reported available until verification and registration are confirmed.
Existing source identity and resulting artifact version are recorded separately with provenance.
rightsPrivacy: Data classification, purpose, consent, locality, residency, egress, retention, training/secondary use, and source/derivative obligations remain independent policy axes.
Minimize sensitive data and retain no provider copy or derived biometric/identity material absent explicit authority.
capabilities.cancellationRetryReconciliation: Reconcile an uncertain import by the same idempotency identity and source reference. Do not refetch an external source or create a duplicate artifact after an unknown outcome without owner reconciliation.
explicitUnsupportedCases: Importing from arbitrary URLs or untrusted remote sources without owner-defined allowlists, SSRF controls, locality, and egress policy.
Treating successful source resolution as integrity verification, project attachment, or rights clearance.
